failure_evidence.summary: The agent reaches iron acquisition in several episodes but does not convert that state into diamond collection before termination.
Two clipped rollouts show repeated vertical mining in mountain stone without torch placement or branch exploration.
Voxel slices indicate nearby ore pockets are visible late in the trajectory, but the agent fails to orient or descend toward them.
